recipe.title: Soupe de poisson épicée au manioc
recipe.description: Une soupe légère et réconfortante à base de filets de thiof, manioc et piment, idéale pour le dîner.
instructions: Épluche le manioc, coupe-le en dés de 2 cm et réserve.
Émince l'oignon et les deux tomates.
Dans une grande marmite, porte les 1,2 l d'eau à feu moyen.
Ajoute les dés de manioc et laisse cuire 10 minutes, jusqu'à ce qu'ils deviennent tendres (piquer avec la pointe d'un couteau).
Incorpore l'oignon émincé, les tomates coupées et le piment entier, puis laisse mijoter 5 minutes de plus.
Ajoute les filets de thiof coupés en morceaux de 3 cm, sale et poivre, puis porte à ébullition douce.
Continue la cuisson 12 minutes à feu doux, jusqu'à ce que le poisson soit opaque et se détache facilement (température interne 63 °C).
Retire le piment, ajuste l'assaisonnement, puis sers la soupe bien chaude.
tips: Pour plus de profondeur, ajoute une cuillère à café de concentré de tomate en fin de cuisson.

recipes.title: Beef and Spinach Soup

recipe.title: Beef and Spinach Soup
recipe.description: A hearty broth with tender beef, fresh spinach, and aromatic garlic and onion, perfect for a quick midday meal.
instructions: Dice the onion into small pieces.
Mince the 3 cloves of garlic.
Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat; add the onion and sauté for 3 minutes, until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and sauté another 1 minute, until fragrant.
Cut the beef into bite‑size cubes and add to the pot; brown the pieces for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in 1.5 l water, bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer.
Simmer for 20 minutes, until the beef is tender and the broth is flavorful.
Check the internal temperature of the beef with a thermometer; it should reach 63 °C, then let rest 3 minutes.
Add the 300 g spinach, stir, and cook for 2 minutes, until the leaves wilt.
Season with 1 pinch salt and 1 pinch black pepper.
Serve hot, optionally with a slice of bread.
tips: Trim any excess fat from the beef before cubing for a cleaner broth.
If you prefer a thicker soup, blend half of the spinach and broth, then return to the pot.

recipes.title: Plantain and Peanut Beef Stew

recipe.title: Plantain and Peanut Beef Stew
recipe.description: A rich, thick stew where sweet plantains and creamy peanuts complement tender beef, echoing Central African flavors.
instructions: Peel the plantains and cut them into 2‑cm thick rounds.
Dice the onion and mince the 2 cloves of garlic.
Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat; add the onion and sauté for 4 minutes, until softened.
Add the garlic and sauté 1 more minute.
Cut the beef into 2‑cm cubes; add to the pot and brown for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Check the beef temperature; it should reach 63 °C, then let rest 3 minutes.
Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes to develop flavor.
Add the plantain rounds, pour in 800 ml water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for 30 minutes, until the plantains are soft and the beef is tender.
While the stew simmers, toast the raw peanuts in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes, stirring frequently, then grind them coarsely.
Add the toasted peanuts to the pot, stir, and simmer uncovered for 5 more minutes to thicken the sauce.
Season with 1 pinch salt and 1 pinch black pepper.
Serve hot, optionally with boiled rice or boiled cassava.
tips: If you prefer a smoother sauce, blend half of the stew before adding the peanuts.

recipe.title: Spicy Beef, Spinach and Peanut Stir-Fry
recipe.description: Quick pan‑fried beef strips with wilted spinach, crunchy peanuts and a touch of heat, ideal for a satisfying lunch.
instructions: Slice the beef into thin strips.
Rinse the spinach and pat dry.
Dice the onion and mince the 2 cloves of garlic.
Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add the beef strips and stir‑fry for 3 minutes, until browned but not fully cooked; set aside.
In the same wok, add the onion and garlic; stir‑fry for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chili powder and soy sauce, stir quickly.
Return the beef to the wok and continue stir‑frying for 2 more minutes, checking that the internal temperature reaches 63 °C (use a thermometer).
Add the spinach and toss for 1 minute, until the leaves wilt.
Toast the raw peanuts in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 minutes, then crush them coarsely and sprinkle over the stir‑fry.
Season with a pinch of salt, give a final toss, and serve immediately over cooked rice or boiled plantain slices.
tips: Cut the beef against the grain for maximum tenderness.
If you like extra heat, add a sliced fresh chili during the onion sauté.

recipe.title: Sopa picante de col y lentejas rojas
recipe.description: Una sopa ligera y reconfortante, perfecta para la cena. Combina col crujiente y lentejas rojas, aromatizada con jengibre y un toque de picante.
instructions: Pica la col en tiras finas, la cebolla y la zanahoria en cubos pequeños, y ralla el jengibre.
Calienta el aceite vegetal en una olla a fuego medio y sofríe la cebolla durante 3 minutos, hasta que esté translúcida.
Añade el jengibre rallado y el chile en polvo, y cocina 1 minuto más, sin que se queme.
Incorpora la col y la zanahoria, y saltea 4 minutos, removiendo frecuentemente, hasta que la col empiece a ablandarse.
Agrega las lentejas rojas, el agua, la sal y la pimienta. Lleva a ebullición, luego reduce a fuego bajo.
Deja hervir a fuego lento durante 25 minutos, o hasta que las lentejas estén tiernas y la sopa tenga una consistencia espesa.
Prueba y ajusta de sal o picante si es necesario. Sirve caliente.
tips: Si prefieres una sopa más líquida, añade 200 ml de agua extra al final.
Puedes sustituir el chile en polvo por una pizca de pimentón dulce si no te gusta el picante.

tips: Para un toque más aromático, puedes añadir una hoja de laurel al caldo.
